name: ft-lookup-idor
description: R210 P2 (security plan section 2 / section 5): the lookup IDOR probe, member leg. Jordan Lee (plain member, the real scrypt door) fetches the moderator's user-lookup door with his own session: the search (?q=), the detail (?userId=u_me), and the bare door must all refuse with 403 (the R206 grammar, live in the browser).

steps.name: lookup-search-403
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/moderation/user-lookup?q=jordan', false); x.send(); return 'status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()

steps.name: lookup-detail-idor-403
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/moderation/user-lookup?userId=u_me', false); x.send(); return 'status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()

steps.name: lookup-bare-door-403-before-400
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/moderation/user-lookup', false); x.send(); return 'status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()
